record.paper_title: On the combinatorics of tableaux -- A notebook of open problems
record.original_question: Find a combinatorial interpretation for Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials.

evidence.quote: [Bren2024, Prob. 1.10] Find a combinatorial interpretation for Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(W,S)$ be a Coxeter system with Bruhat order $\leq$. For $u,v \in W$ with $u \leq v$, the Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomial $P_{u,v}(q) \in \mathbb{Z}[q]$ is uniquely determined by the following recursion. Let $H = \bigoplus_{w \in W} \mathbb{Z}[q^{1/2},q^{-1/2}] T_w$ be the Hecke algebra of $(W,S)$, with multiplication $(T_s - q)(T_s + 1) = 0$ for $s \in S$ and $T_u T_v = T_{uv}$ when $\ell(uv) = \ell(u)+\ell(v)$, and let $\iota$ be the involution sending $q^{1/2} \mapsto q^{-1/2}$ and $T_w \mapsto T_{w^{-1}}^{-1}$. Then for each $v \in W$ there is a unique element 
$$C_v' = q^{-\ell(v)/2} \sum_{u \leq v} P_{u,v}(q)\, T_u$$
that is fixed by $\iota$ and satisfies $\deg P_{u,v} \leq \tfrac{1}{2}(\ell(v) - \ell(u) - 1)$ for $u < v$, with $P_{v,v} = 1$. Equivalently, the coefficients $P_{u,v}(q)$ are computed by the Kazhdan–Lusztig recursion.

It is known that $P_{u,v}(q)$ has nonnegative integer coefficients (in arbitrary Coxeter groups, by work of Elias–Williamson via the Hodge theory of Soergel bimodules).

Problem. Provide a combinatorial interpretation for the coefficients of $P_{u,v}(q)$: that is, exhibit, for every Coxeter system $(W,S)$ and every pair $u \leq v$ in $W$, an explicitly described finite set $\mathcal{S}_{u,v}$ equipped with a statistic $\mathrm{stat}: \mathcal{S}_{u,v} \to \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$ such that
$$P_{u,v}(q) = \sum_{x \in \mathcal{S}_{u,v}} q^{\mathrm{stat}(x)}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: Finding a manifestly nonnegative combinatorial formula for Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials of arbitrary Coxeter groups (and even of symmetric groups) is a long-standing open problem. While positivity has been established (Elias–Williamson, 2014) and combinatorial formulas are known in special cases (e.g. for Grassmannian permutations via Lascoux–Schützenberger, for covexillary permutations, and partial results via Deodhar's defect statistic on subexpressions which depends on choices), no general combinatorial interpretation is known as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: The Hodge theory of Soergel bimodules
status_evidence.snippet: Elias and Williamson prove the Kazhdan–Lusztig positivity conjecture for arbitrary Coxeter groups, but the proof is not combinatorial.
status_evidence.claim: Positivity is known but no general combinatorial interpretation is provided.

status_evidence.title: Brenti, Combinatorial properties of Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials (survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys known combinatorial results and lists the problem of finding a combinatorial interpretation of KL polynomials as a major open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Problem is widely cited as open in the combinatorics literature.
